_schema.description: Election news per district and statewide, refreshed four times a day by scripts/refresh.py from publishers' RSS feeds and news sitemaps, and Bing News RSS searches (per district, and per outlet where its own site can't be read). Headline, outlet, date and link only; article text is never stored.

fields.updated: ISO UTC time of the last refresh
fields.statewide: Up to 50 latest items about the state election: [{title, outlet, published (ISO UTC), url}]
fields.seats: District id -> up to 10 latest items mentioning the district, its sitting MP or a candidate by full name
fields.sources: Source (outlet, the Bing News search, the leader searches, or articles added by hand) -> {status: ok | error | skipped, via: feed | sitemap | Bing News search | news_manual.json, url (what was read), page (the outlet's election page, if any), items (items read this run), last_7_days (election headlines from it dated in the last 7 days), message}
